title: ADA Transition Plan - Village of Ottawa
short_description: Consulting services for an ADA transition plan assessing accessibility barriers in Ottawa, Ohio.
project_scope: Preparation of an ADA Transition Plan for the Village of Ottawa, including a comprehensive assessment of pedestrian facilities, public buildings, parks, and the municipal website to identify accessibility barriers and define a prioritized schedule of improvements.
services: Consulting and planning services for ADA transition planning; assessment of accessibility barriers; planning/master planning; civil engineering; rehabilitation and refurbishment input; landscape architecture; interior design/space planning.
relevance_explanation:
- This is primarily an ADA/accessibility planning study, not structural or detailed design work.
- Scope focuses on assessment of pedestrian facilities, buildings, parks, and website accessibility rather than bridges or complex load-bearing structures.
- Matches excluded categories such as pure planning/master planning and urban/open-space related consulting.
- No indication of innovative structural systems, long spans, or architecturally demanding engineering.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The notice concerns preparation of a transition plan and prioritization of future improvements, not a defined construction project. Potential future improvement costs cannot be estimated realistically from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the source. As this is a planning/assessment assignment without stated budget, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Planning/Master Planning. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
